entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments: ¶When you sit down to eat with a ruler, Consider carefully what [is] before you;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: And put a knife to your throat If you [are] a man given to appetite.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: Do not desire his delicacies, For they [are] deceptive food.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: ¶Do not overwork to be rich; Because of your own understanding, cease!

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: Will you set your eyes on that which is not? For [riches] certainly make themselves wings; They fly away like an eagle [toward] heaven.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: ¶Do not eat the bread of a miser, Nor desire his delicacies;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: For as he thinks in his heart, so [is] he. "Eat and drink!" he says to you, But his heart is not with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: The morsel you have eaten, you will vomit up, And waste your pleasant words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: ¶Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, For he will despise the wisdom of your words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: ¶Do not remove the ancient landmark, Nor enter the fields of the fatherless;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: For their Redeemer [is] mighty; He will plead their cause against you.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:12
segments: ¶Apply your heart to instruction, And your ears to words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: Do not withhold correction from a child, For [if] you beat him with a rod, he will not die.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:14
segments: You shall beat him with a rod, And deliver his soul from hell.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:15
segments: My son, if your heart is wise, My heart will rejoice-indeed, I myself;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: Yes, my inmost being will rejoice When your lips speak right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:17
segments: ¶Do not let your heart envy sinners, But [be zealous] for the fear of the LORD all the day;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: For surely there is a hereafter, And your hope will not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: ¶Hear, my son, and be wise; And guide your heart in the way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:20
segments: Do not mix with winebibbers, [Or] with gluttonous eaters of meat;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:21
segments: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, And drowsiness will clothe [a man] with rags.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:22
segments: Listen to your father who begot you, And do not despise your mother when she is old.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: Buy the truth, and do not sell [it, Also] wisdom and instruction and understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:24
segments: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice, And he who begets a wise [child] will delight in him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:25
segments: Let your father and your mother be glad, And let her who bore you rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: My son, give me your heart, And let your eyes observe my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:27
segments: For a harlot [is] a deep pit, And a seductress [is] a narrow well.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:28
segments: She also lies in wait as [for] a victim, And increases the unfaithful among men.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:29
segments: ¶Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: Those who linger long at the wine, Those who go in search of mixed wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: Do not look on the wine when it is red, When it sparkles in the cup, [When] it swirls around smoothly;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:32
segments: At the last it bites like a serpent, And stings like a viper.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:33
segments: Your eyes will see strange things, And your heart will utter perverse things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: Yes, you will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, Or like one who lies at the top of the mast, [saying]:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: "They have struck me, [but] I was not hurt; They have beaten me, but I did not feel [it]. When shall I awake, that I may seek another [drink]?"
